problem: The prereg names archive_market as odds_series_b grid71 while separately requiring all calibration matches to have archive match_datetime < 2016-03-01 00:00:00. Direct archive inspection proves odds_series_b begins on 2016-03-01, so that literal filename cannot contain any prereg-eligible calibration row.

resolution.interpretation: Treat odds_series.csv.gz and odds_series_b.csv.gz as consecutive archive partitions of the same grid71 H/D/A market schema. Use the pre-2016-03-01 partition odds_series for prereg calibration and the post-boundary partition odds_series_b for the already frozen target300.

prohibitions: do not reinterpret this as permission to substitute a different market schema
do not use target300 outcomes to fit or select alpha
do not change the frozen target sample
do not change the grid71 construction rule
